scoring_justification: The P and free energy derivative require full APFC simulation; the verifier cannot re-run it. Comparing agent-reported values against digitized paper reference with tolerances and trend checks is appropriate.

schema.description: Each row corresponds to one simulation condition (epsilon, s_f). H_c is critical thickness in unit cells. P is inverse critical thickness computed as (1+log(H_c))/H_c. free_energy_derivative is the change in free energy derivative at critical thickness.

outputs.description: CSV file containing extracted critical thickness and free energy derivative for six configurations of misfit epsilon and film shear s_f.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares reported P and free_energy_derivative against the paper's published values for the given configurations, with tolerances accounting for implementation differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for P and free energy derivative at vicinal angle theta=6.178deg, positive misfit, used to score results.csv.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from paper Figure 4(b) for P values and Figure 6 for free energy derivative change.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted via digitization of the published figures and cross-validated with the paper description. The numbers are consistent with reported trends.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published simulation results; using the paper's own data as the gold standard is the correct target for reproduction verification.

steps.description: Validate results.csv against hidden gold: P within absolute tolerance 0.05, free energy derivative within relative 15%, and physical trend checks.
